AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
This app manages personal notes and can display them on the user's connected display glasses.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'showLatestNotes' to display the N most recent notes on the glasses. - Use 'searchNotesOnGlasses' to display notes whose title or text contains a given query.
Constraints: - Both functions require at least one existing note; otherwise no notes are shown.
